entities.description: Yellow auto-rickshaw parked half on the footpath.
Concrete utility pole at the outer edge of the footpath.
Tree with low branches hanging over the footpath.
Pothole in the carriageway near the centre line.
Shop signboard standing on the footpath.
Open drain where the footpath slab is broken.
Rubble heap where the footpath is missing.
